id.description: HTML id applied to the dropdown root element. Auto-generated when omitted.

open.description: Controls the open state of the dropdown menu; bindable for controlled usage.

placement.description:
Preferred menu placement relative to the trigger. Default `bottom-start`.
The rendered menu may still flip to stay within the viewport.

class.description: Additional class names merged with the component's root class.

sheetBelow.description:
Viewport width below which the menu docks to the bottom edge as a sheet,
with the bottom Drawer's geometry, instead of anchoring to its trigger.
Keyboard, focus, and dismissal behave exactly as when anchored. A simple
CSS length such as `'640px'`, or `false` to always anchor. Default
`'640px'`.
